entries.name: apricot-violet
entries.good_for: Heatmaps, density renders and continuous covariates on embeddings, on a white page.
entries.avoid: Reversing it: a dark low end hides low values on white.
entries.why: The low end is tinted, not white, so low values stay visible; lightness falls monotonically.

entries.name: steel-blue
entries.good_for: A per-modality map that matches the steel blue of modality-pair.
entries.avoid: Next to another blue data class.
entries.why: Single hue, so the map reads as the same modality as its accent color.

entries.name: ylgnbu
entries.good_for: Gene expression on maps and 3D scatters, scaled to the 1st-99th percentile of expressing cells, non-expressing cells faint grey.
entries.avoid: Very small dots: the yellow low end disappears on white; use ylgnbu-trunc there.
entries.why: Chosen over four other colormaps; the strong-weak contrast reads clearly.

entries.name: ylgnbu-trunc
entries.good_for: Small expression thumbnails over a light grey ghost of the other cells.
entries.avoid: Large heatmaps, where the full range is fine.
entries.why: Dropping the near-white low end keeps weak expression visible on small dots.

entries.name: rdbu-r-centered
entries.good_for: log2 enrichment or fold change, with a symmetric norm centered at 0.
entries.why: White at zero lets depletion and enrichment read as two directions.

entries.name: tint-shade-families
entries.good_for: Two-level labels (classes and their subtypes): a class uses its main color, its members sit on the main color's tint-shade surface.
entries.avoid: Flat palettes with many unrelated labels; members of one family are meant to look related.
entries.why: Hue separates families and sub-families, lightness separates members, so the hierarchy is visible without a legend.
entries.origin: Main colors from the published palette of Shi et al. 2023 (Nature), largely matplotlib tab20; members generated around each main color (chroma follows lightness), then tuned so neighbors differ.

entries.name: atlas-regions-20
entries.good_for: Up to 20 spatial domains on a map, with dark entries for small or thin structures.
entries.avoid: Dot-heavy plots where the near-black entries vanish.
entries.why: A published atlas palette that readers of the field recognise.
entries.origin: Region palette of Shi et al. 2023 (Nature), 20-color subset.

entries.name: modality-pair
entries.good_for: Two assays or modalities throughout a figure: histograms, accents, half-page tints.
entries.avoid: Pages whose data colors include violet or blue classes.
entries.why: Calm, distinct hues that do not clash with pink or teal highlight colors.

entries.name: highlight-pair
entries.good_for: A positive class and its nested subset (teal, then pink) over grey or ghosted cells.
entries.avoid: Next to accents in the same hues.
entries.why: Strong contrast with each other and with grey.

entries.name: neutral-grey
entries.good_for: Unclassified or no-type cells, background ghosts.

entries.name: apricot-violet-reversed
entries.why: Compared side by side with apricot-violet in review; the original direction was preferred.

entries.name: pink-mint-pair
entries.avoid: Pages that also use a pink or teal data class.
entries.why: As modality accents they clashed with the pink highlight class, making the page ambiguous.
